verdict.rationale: Parahelp's docs define an automation as an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule (e.g., every weekday at 9am) or on a trigger such as a GitHub PR merge. Automations are managed from a dedicated Automations page with templates. They can be set to auto-approve so they run unattended, and they can watch tools and the support queue on their own. Missing for 10: detail on schedule configuration options (cron-style flexibility, time zones), run history and failure monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
